finding: NEITHER AVAILABLE READ SETTLES AUT-PROP-048, AND THEY ARE CONFOUNDED IN OPPOSITE DIRECTIONS — so no refutation was written and no control test was relaxed. (1) The two blocks are the same reduction: over 197 (GSE24369) and 185 (GSE4303) genes present in both, z agrees to max |delta| 0.000000, so the wide read is not a normalisation artifact. (2) The null's move is a POOL effect and not a panel-size one: swept over k = 10..231 at 500 draws the null median is flat at -0.067..+0.008 in the curated pool and +0.086..+0.129 in the wide one, tracking rho(NDRG1, whole-pool centroid) of -0.0543 and +0.0882. (3) The wide read's null pool is mostly the panels it is a null for: 61.5% panel members, 43.1% PPARg members, against 27.2% / 14.9% curated. (4) AND THE CURATED READ'S MEMBERS ARE A SELECTED SUBSET OF EACH PANEL, which is the confound that manufactures the committed verdict and the one the size-matched null structurally cannot see, because it draws from a POOL and never from the PANEL: in GSE24369 all six hypoxia panels' curated subsets sit in the upper tail of their own panel's within-panel distribution (100.0th, 97.3rd, 89.9th, 86.4th, 77.6th, 72.3rd) while the PPARg subsets straddle the middle (3.9 to 82.6, median 55). hypoxia_gobp_response scores +0.7445 over its 22 curated members and +0.2353 over all 72. (5) On GSE4303 that asymmetry is absent, consistent with the curation having been driven by the larger series rather than by chance.

anti_gaming.invariant: research-loop §6 — a bar may not be changed by the cycle the bar just blocked.
anti_gaming.how_it_was_honoured: The four control tests that pin the narrow finding were NOT touched, NOT relaxed and NOT skipped; they pass unchanged. The wide read was not adopted. The only bar that moved is upward: a new guard file, and a new assertion that our own committed verdict rests on a selected subset. AUT-PD-170 records that a LATER cycle may move MEMBERSHIP_SOURCE and those four tests, because a later cycle is not the cycle they blocked.
anti_gaming.self_serving_check: Does this change make it easier for me to report success? The pin makes a red test green, so the honest answer is that it could. Against that: it adopts no reversal, it weakens no assertion, it adds a control that DOWNGRADES the repository's own result, and the verdict headline and systems/graph now say the reading is conditional where they previously stated it flat. The defect being fixed is the silent inheritance itself — a generator that switched its entire scientific reading because a workflow pushed a file — and that is a defect whichever value the constant takes.

escalated: nothing. research-loop §5 names five triggers and none applies: no journal submission, no spend, no goal-changing fact, no health condition past its deadline, no paper ready to post.

subagents.why: One item, one diagnostic chain, each step's question set by the previous step's answer. Nothing here was independent enough to fan out, and the driver had to hold the argument.

route_advanced_why: The route's only committed positive result was measured and found to rest on a selection artifact its own control could not see; the artifact, the graph and the ledger now state it at that weight, and the read that settles it is filed and free. Correcting the strength of a live route's own claim, with the deciding experiment named, is advancing it — the alternative was a manuscript inheriting an overclaim.
